remarks: Discover the perfect blend of comfort and convenience in this freshly painted one-bedroom apartment located in the sought-after Woodside Green complex. Featuring hardwood floors, large sunlit rooms, newer windows, and a kitchen with new stainless steel appliances, this charming corner unit is ideal for first-time buyers, downsizers, or those seeking a great rental alternative. The well-managed, pet-friendly complex offers beautifully landscaped grounds with a central green, walkways, grills, a gazebo, a secure bike room, and plenty of onsite parking. Enjoy the unbeatable location, less than 2 miles to the train station, with easy access to major routes and walkable amenities like LA Fitness, Starbucks, Scalzi Park, and Ridgeway Shopping Center. With hot water and cooking gas included in the common charges, this is low-maintenance living at its best. Woodside Green offers a friendly community atmosphere, perfect for those seeking convenience, charm, and a commuter-friendly lifestyle. Don't miss this fantastic opportunity!
